name: Glen Elendra
description: Glen Elendra is the secluded haven of the queen of the fae on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, a valley shielded by glamers.

bio.text: Oona, the faerie queen, dwelt in Glen Elendra and plotted to remain in power and unchanged through the plane's transformation when she sensed the Great Aurora approaching.

citations.text: Lorwyn: card flavor text (Lorwyn, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: The Vendilion clique whisked Maralen away to Glen Elendra as a gift to Oona.

bio.text: Oona was defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor and the combined power of Maralen and Ashling's elemental, and Maralen became queen of the fae.

citations.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Maralen then ruled the plane from Glen Elendra, and the palace expanded to fit her.

timeline.summary: After Oona's defeat, Maralen becomes the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: After Oona's defeat, Maralen became the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra and stewards the plane.

citation.text: "Faerie", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona creates a pair of fae from a petal of her body to carry her memories into the coming world; the first, Oko, is deemed a failure and flees.
timeline.quote: As a contingency, Oona took a petal from her floral body and used it to create a pair of fae that could each carry her memories forward into the coming world.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona senses the Great Aurora approaching prematurely and plots to remain in power and unchanged through the plane's transformation.
timeline.quote: Oona began to plot to ensure that she remained in power and unchanged when the plane’s transformation occurred.

citation.text: "Oona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona creates the Vendilion siblings in the final days before the Great Aurora.
timeline.quote: The Vendilion siblings were created by the Great Mother Oona in the final days before the Great Aurora

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The clique whisks Maralen away to Glen Elendra as a gift to Oona.
timeline.quote: the siblings had whisked her away to Glen Elendra as a gift to their queen.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The clique learns Maralen is a faerie duplicate and begins to obey her.
timeline.quote: the clique was informed then of Maralen's origins as a faerie duplicate

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona creates two faerie siblings, the first of whom, Oko, is meant to rule Shadowmoor but rebels.
timeline.quote: This sibling rebelled and desired to rule in adherence to the natural cycle of the world

citation.text: "Oona", section "The Shadowmoor prince". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona raises her younger daughter in seclusion and deprives her of warmth as a weapon against the coming aurora.
timeline.quote: The faerie was reared to be a weapon against the world that Oona feared would rise against her

citation.text: "Oona", section "The Shadowmoor prince". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4520 AR Oona spies on Colfenor through the Vendilion clique, which she created as scouts.
timeline.quote: a trio of faerie emissaries that she created in the face of the Great Aurora to act as her personal scouts and spies

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the elf Maralen and replaces her with her half-formed daughter, who gains unintended sentience; the Vendilion bring her before Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona used her magic to kill an elf woman named Maralen and replaced her with her half-formed daughter

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor and the combined power of Maralen and Ashling's elemental; Maralen becomes queen of the fae as day returns.
timeline.quote: Maralen took her place as queen of the fae as day returned to the plane.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Though her body is destroyed, Oona's consciousness survives in the plane and she creates a new trio of faeries to replace the Vendilion.
timeline.quote: she created a new trio of Faeries to replace the Vendilion clique

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the Sapling of Colfenor, and Rhys absorbs its poison.
timeline.quote: Oona killed the Sapling of Colfenor in a final act of spite

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen deals Oona the killing blow with moonglove.
timeline.quote: Maralen dealt the killing blow using moonglove

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is reborn in secret in Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: she was shown to be reborn, her essence reconstituted in secret.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen gives Rhys the moonglove and instructs him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return.
timeline.quote: Maralen gave the moonglove to Rhys and instructed him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys is granted eternal life until he can fulfill his oath.
timeline.quote: Rhys was granted eternal life until he was able to carry out his oath-sworn duty.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko manipulates Rhys into believing Maralen is becoming Oona, and Rhys moves to strike her.
timeline.quote: He brandished his moonglow-tipped dagger against Maralen, but she escaped.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the sapling and the groundlings; Endry survives losing a wing.
timeline.quote: Oona unleashed a counterattack, killing the sapling by cutting her in two with a thornvine

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Rhys and Ashling destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: destroyed Oona by a combination of poison, fire, and water magic.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tamira and Sanar find Maralen turning into Oona; Tamira makes Rhys miss his attack and Maralen enlists their help.
timeline.quote: Tamira used probability magic to make him miss his attack and fall out a window

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko returns to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and finds Maralen ruling Glen Elendra, plotting a trick that draws Strixhaven students there.
timeline.quote: he found Maralen ruling over Glen Elendra

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds herself to Rhys with a death pact.
timeline.quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys with a death pact.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The blue faerie slips through the briar hedge into Glen Elendra, reverts to a blue Lorwyn faerie in the light and sneaks into Maralen's flock.
timeline.quote: a small blue Lorwyn faerie stood where the green faerie had been

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The faerie drops a sprig of foxglove on the sleeping Maralen's pillow.
timeline.quote: dropping its sprig of foxglove onto the pillow of the figure sleeping there.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen wakes from a terrible dream, sensing something is very wrong.
timeline.quote: With a gasp, Maralen awoke and sat upright in her bed

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Camey reports that the faerie Aherin is missing and that someone is using his bed, making the flock seem to number thirty-five.
timeline.quote: But now there are thirty- four of us, and Aherin is missing

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys visits Maralen, who is reminded of the pact by which he would kill her if she followed Oona's path.
timeline.quote: Should she show any sign that her slow transformations had started to lead her down her creator's path, Rhys would kill her

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen briefly sees a third figure of living flower petals in her mirror and hears ghostly laughter, which Rhys cannot hear.
timeline.quote: it looked like there was a third person in the room with them, smaller, made entirely of living flower petals and glaring at her with unending menace.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen flees to the courtyard to find comfort with Eirdu.
timeline.quote: Hello, old friend,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: As Eirdu leaves, patches of Shadowmoor open in the courtyard, and the blue faerie transforms back to green and follows Maralen.
timeline.quote: letting its transformation repeat in reverse, blue becoming green, smoothness becoming jagged and ornate.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Brigid tells the students to flee and explains how to reach Glen Elendra, warning them not to listen to anyone who begs them to turn around.
timeline.quote: When I step through this door, you run, you understand me?

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen finds petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and realizes her independence may be unraveling.
timeline.quote: These were the petals of Oona's flesh, and they couldn't be here, unless—

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen sees Oona's gaze in the mirror and hears laughter.
timeline.quote: she met the terrible gaze of Oona and pushed herself away from the mirror so hard

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Faeries bring Tam and Sanar to Maralen, and Tam says Brigid sent them.
timeline.quote: I'm a gorgon. My name is Tam—Brigid sent us.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells the students Oona is returning and she does not know if she can stop her.
timeline.quote: Oona is returning, and this time, I don't know if I can stop her.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys bursts in with the blue faerie and attacks Maralen with a dagger to keep his promise.
timeline.quote: The elf drew a dagger from his belt and lunged.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys slips on flower petals and tumbles out a window.
timeline.quote: Rhys took two wild, stumbling steps and tumbled out of a nearby window.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen explains the death pact and flees with Tam, Sanar and the blue faerie before Rhys returns.
timeline.quote: But I'm not ready to die, and if we can settle Isilu and restore the cycle, I may not have to.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Sanar and Tam escape the palace by blowing the bud off a giant stem with Sanar's improvised explosive and sliding down it.
timeline.quote: The bud exploded, sending sticky chunks flying in all directions.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko declines to stay and rule, but Maralen offers him a home in Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: But I love my freedom too much to be confined.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen, originally an avatar of Oona, becomes steward of the plane from Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: Originally an avatar of Oona, Maralen is now the steward of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor alongside Eirdu and Isilu

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Maralen sequesters Eirdu within her palace grounds, fearing Oona's return.
timeline.quote: As her fears of Oona's influence began to consume her, Maralen had come to sequester Eirdu within her palace grounds.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Queenhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Forty years into her reign Oko returns and exploits Maralen's paranoia, betraying her fears to Rhys.
timeline.quote: but Oko betrayed her secret fears to Rhys

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Moonglove and Dawnglove". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona fell and Maralen assumed control as queen of the fae; the palace expanded to fit her.
timeline.quote: After her fall, Maralen assumed control as the queen of the plane's fae

citation.text: "Glen Elendra", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona, queen of the faeries, causes the plane's transformation.
timeline.quote: for it was their queen, Oona, who caused it.
